content:
Ethereum holds most of the on-chain value
Ethereum has proven very early on that, in my view, it is not just a token or a testing platform, but a systemically scaled asset.
$ETH reached a valuation milestone of 500 billion USD faster than any company or large asset in history; Bitcoin followed with about 12 years.
For me, this clearly reflects the speed of value accumulation and the level of acceptance of Ethereum right from the early cycles.
However, at the current moment, the market is still valuing ETH as a relatively small part of the total market capitalization of cryptocurrencies, despite the fact that most of the value operating on-chain — from DeFi, stablecoins, to core infrastructure applications — is concentrated on Ethereum.
Therefore, from my perspective, there is a clear phase shift: Ethereum is taking on most of the 'work' of the ecosystem, but the current market valuation does not seem to fully reflect its role, level of usage, and true importance.
